print(p.stdout)

 s=Path('sources/'+n+'-metadata.html').read_text();s=re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',s);s=re.sub(r'\s+',' ',s)
 a=s.find('Submission history');print(n,s[max(0,a-2400):a+1300])
